screen: tm-dash-admin — Talent Management: Talent Dashboard + Administration & Governance (Admin Center)
screenLevelGaps: VERDICT ON THE DASHBOARD KPIs — THE CUSTOMER'S SUSPICION IS WRONG. All 12 KPI numbers on the Talent Dashboard are REAL, computed by TalentDashboardController from real tables (talent_job_postings, talent_job_applications, talent_offers, talent_onboarding_journeys, s_performance_reviews, talent_mobility_requests, talent_offboarding_cases/_clearances). The controller returns null rather than a fabricated 0 for figures it cannot derive (candidate_trend_pct, avg_time_to_hire_days, offer_acceptance_rate, avg_completion_days), and the UI renders 'No hires yet'/'No offers extended'/'No data'. There is not a single hardcoded number in talent-dashboard.tsx. This is the most honestly-built screen in the Talent module.

VERDICT ON ADMINISTRATION — THE SUSPICION IS CORRECT AND WORSE THAN STATED. Administration configures workflow names, stages and approver chains (talent_workflows / talent_workflow_stages / talent_workflow_approvers, migration 2026_07_30_111143). grep across the entire backend proves those three tables are read by EXACTLY ONE file: AdminWorkflowController.php. No Talent sub-module — recruitment, onboarding, performance, mobility, offboarding — reads a workflow, a stage or an approver. MobilityRequestController.php:226-247 implements its own hardcoded single-step approve/reject writing reviewed_by, ignoring the seeded 'Promotion Approval' (Mobility) workflow entirely. Onboarding seeds its own 7 stages per journey from talent_onboarding_journey_stages, not from the seeded 'Onboarding Checklist' workflow. The Administration screen is a decorative catalogue of workflow *descriptions* with zero enforcement anywhere.

BLOCKING BUG — WORKFLOW DETAIL DRAWER IS PERMANENTLY EMPTY. AdminWorkflowController::show() exists (AdminWorkflowController.php:84-140) but routes/api.php registers ONLY line 1219 `Route::get('/talent/admin/workflows', [AdminWorkflowController::class, 'index'])`. There is no route for `/talent/admin/workflows/{id}`. Clicking any table row (admin-center.tsx:281) calls AdminService.getWorkflowById (admin-service.ts:29-32) → GET /api/talent/admin/workflows/wf-1 → Laravel 404 → apiClient throws ApiError (api-client.ts:106) → caught at admin-center.tsx:101 → console.error only. activeWorkflowId is set so the Sheet OPENS, but activeWorkflow stays null so `activeWorkflow && (...)` (admin-center.tsx:384) renders nothing. The user gets a blank 4xl-wide drawer with no error, no close affordance except the overlay. EVERY workflow row does this. Consequence: the Workflow Stages diagram, the Approvers table, and all 5 detail fields are unreachable in the running product.

BLOCKING BUG — THE ADMIN 'ALL MODULES' FILTER IS A NO-OP. admin-center.tsx:221-222 passes `onValueChange={(val) => { setModule(val); setPage(1); }}` to `<Select>`. components/ui/select.tsx:11-22 defines SelectProps with `onChange`, NOT `onValueChange`; the prop is destructured at select.tsx:25 and `onValueChange` is silently dropped. select.tsx:232 calls `onChange?.(opt.value)` — undefined — so picking Recruitment/Onboarding/Performance/Mobility/Offboarding changes nothing. `module` is permanently 'all'. The backend filter (AdminWorkflowController.php:34) is correct and unreachable. Note the sibling file talent-dashboard.tsx:362 uses the correct `onChange` — so this is a local defect, not a design choice.

BLOCKING BUG — EVERY DASHBOARD NAVIGATION TARGET IS A DEAD URL. talent-dashboard.tsx:220-222 `moduleHref` builds `/module/talent-management/${menuId}/${menuId}`, e.g. `/module/talent-management/recruitment/recruitment`. The real tblmenumaster_g2g access_links, as recorded in content-map-m3.ts:14-21, are SINGLE-segment: `/module/talent-management/recruitment`, `/module/talent-management/onboarding`, `/module/talent-management/performance-reviews-and-appraisals`, `/module/talent-management/mobility-and-succession`, `/module/talent-management/offboarding`. use-sidebar-navigation.ts:147-155 resolves routes by EXACT pathname match against those access_links, so parseRoutePath returns null, ActiveNav never changes, and use-content-map.ts:34-40 falls through to `routes.find(r => r.menuId === active.menuId)` — which re-resolves to the Talent Dashboard itself. Net effect: all 6 KPI tiles, all 3 'View Details' links, the 'View All' link, all 6 action-item rows and all 8 Quick Links push a junk URL and re-render the same dashboard. Two of the menu ids are wrong on top of that ('performance' vs 'performance-reviews-and-appraisals', 'mobility-succession' vs 'mobility-and-succession'). The inline comment at talent-dashboard.tsx:219 ('Menus without submenus route to themselves - see getRoutePath in the shell') misreads use-sidebar-navigation.ts:130 — that line duplicates the ActiveNav *id*, never the URL *segment*.

THE DATE RANGE FILTER IS INERT ACROSS THE WHOLE PAGE EXCEPT ONE FOOTNOTE. TalentDashboardController::index (line 568-592) computes [$from,$to] and passes them ONLY to kpis(). Inside kpis(), $from/$to are used ONLY to compute candidate_trend_pct (lines 113-120). pipeline(), performanceCycle(), onboardingProgress(), actionItems() and activity() take no window argument at all. So the date picker changes exactly one string ('▲ 12% vs previous period') while all 12 headline numbers, both donuts, the 5 funnel stages, time-to-hire, offer acceptance, all 6 action items and the activity feed remain all-time totals. 'Candidate Pipeline' in particular shows an all-time application count with a period-over-period trend underneath it — two different time bases in one tile.

THE DEPARTMENT FILTER IS APPLIED INCONSISTENTLY. Applied to: job postings, applications, offers, onboarding journeys (dept+location), offboarding cases (dept only). NOT applied to: s_performance_reviews (documented as deliberate at TalentDashboardController.php:128-133), talent_mobility_requests (undocumented — the Mobility KPI ignores the filter with no comment), the performance-cycle donut, all 6 action items, and the entire activity feed. Selecting a department therefore filters 6 of 12 KPIs and leaves the bottom third of the page tenant-wide, with no visual signal that the cards disagree.

ZERO COMPETENCY SIGNAL ON THE TALENT DASHBOARD. Per the customer's Integration Points, Competency DEFINES & MEASURES skill and Talent ACQUIREs/PLACEs/EVALUATEs/MOVEs against that measure. The dashboard reads s_skill_matrix, user_rating_details, s_users_skills — none of them, zero times. Concretely missing: (a) Open Positions carries no target job-role competency profile; (b) Candidate Pipeline shows no skill-match score even though SkillMatchingController exists in the backend; (c) Mobility shows internal applications with no competency-gap gate; (d) the Performance Cycle donut shows review *counts* but no rating distribution flowing back to s_skill_matrix. Per KNOWN GROUND TRUTH the only writes to s_skill_matrix are two manual admin endpoints in EmployeeCompetencyProfileController — so nothing on this page can be feeding it.

ZERO LMS SIGNAL ON THE TALENT DASHBOARD. LMS BUILDs skill (lms_course_enroll, lms_certificates, sub_std_map). The dashboard never touches them. Concretely missing: (a) the Onboarding Progress donut counts journey status but not mandatory-course completion, which is the substantive half of onboarding; (b) 'Onboarding Tasks Pending' counts talent_onboarding_tasks rows with no notion of a required course; (c) no development-plan / course-completion tile despite lms_course_enroll.status='completed' + completed_at being real and populated. Because app/Events, app/Listeners and app/Observers do not exist, there is no mechanism by which a course completion could ever reach this page — the gap is architectural, not a missing query.

ZERO TASK MANAGEMENT SIGNAL. The ownership model states Task Mgmt EXECUTEs work and is evidence of applied capability. Neither the KPI row, the action items nor the activity feed reads any task table. An 'evidence of applied capability' tile (tasks completed at/above proficiency) is the single most defensible Talent↔Task link in the spec and it is entirely absent.

THE ADMIN CENTER'S ENTIRE KPI ROW IS FABRICATED — AND CONTRADICTS THE TABLE BELOW IT. All 5 values are string literals in admin-data.ts:37-43 ('28', '56', '18', '12', '1,248'), imported at admin-center.tsx:40 and rendered at :157-176. There is no API call for them. TalentWorkflowsSeeder.php:29-126 inserts exactly 8 workflows, 7 of them Active — so 'Active Workflows: 28' sits directly above a paginated table that says 'of 8 workflows'. Worse, real sources exist for two of these: 'Audit Events (30 Days)' could be counted from tbl_user_journey_logs, s_performance_activity_log, talent_onboarding_activity_log or s_competency_activity_log, all of which are real migrated tables.

ADMINISTRATION IS READ-ONLY WITH NO WRITE PATH AT ALL. AdminWorkflowController has only index() and show() — no store, update, destroy, activate or version-bump. routes/api.php has one GET. The 'Create New' button (admin-center.tsx:149) has no onClick, the row overflow menu (:315) has no onClick, the drawer's 'More Actions' (:419) has no onClick. So a customer cannot create, edit, version, activate, deactivate or delete a workflow, an approver or a stage through the product. The only way workflow data enters the system is `php artisan db:seed --class=TalentWorkflowsSeeder`.

5 OF THE 6 ADMINISTRATION TABS ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Templates, Permissions, Integrations, Configuration and Audit & Compliance (admin-center.tsx:185-189) all render the same 'Module Under Construction' panel (:357-368). The header prose at :141-143 promises 'Configure workflows, templates, permissions, integrations and governance' — 4 of those 5 nouns do not exist. Permissions in particular is the one that matters commercially: the platform already has real group-wise rights in tblmenumaster_g2g (see recent commit 6a36e53b 'feat(user): add groupwise rights management for G2G menus'), so this tab should be surfacing an existing subsystem, not a placeholder.

BACKEND DATA-QUALITY DEFECTS IN TalentDashboardController. (1) Trend window overlap, line 116-117: current window is [$from, $to.' 23:59:59'] but prior window is [$priorFrom, $from] — an application created at exactly $from 00:00:00 is counted in BOTH windows, inflating the prior denominator and skewing the trend. (2) pendingClearances() is executed twice per request (line 165 for the KPI and line 402 for the action item) — same query, two round trips. (3) avg_time_to_hire uses a.updated_at as a hire timestamp (documented at lines 231-237); any later edit to a hired row silently inflates the metric — an honest proxy but one that degrades over time with no correction path. (4) offer_acceptance_basis is computed (line 255) and typed (types/talent-dashboard.ts:44) but NEVER rendered — the acceptance rate is shown with no denominator, so 100%-of-1 is visually identical to 100%-of-200.

BACKEND CODE DEFECTS IN AdminWorkflowController::index. (1) N+1 query, line 54: `DB::table('talent_workflows')->where('id',$w->id)->value('updated_by')` inside a map — one extra query per row, on top of line 50 which already fetched the same column into $userIds. (2) Line 50 uses `whereIn('id', $workflows->pluck('id'))` where pluck returns the RAW numeric ids (the 'wf-' prefix is added later at line 68), which happens to be correct, but the whole block is redundant with line 54. (3) index() returns `collect([...])` (line 67) instead of a JsonResponse — it serializes acceptably but bypasses talentResponse() and so returns HTTP 200 even on failure, unlike every other Talent endpoint.

ADMIN 'SHOWING X TO Y OF Z' HARDCODES PAGE SIZE. admin-center.tsx:328 computes `(page-1)*10+1` and `Math.min(page*10, totalItems)` with a literal 10, while the real per_page comes from the API response (`res.pagination.per_page`, available and ignored at admin-center.tsx:76-77). It agrees today only because AdminService never sends per_page and talentPaging defaults to 10 (AdminWorkflowController.php:29). Any change to either default silently produces a wrong count line.

SEARCH-ON-ENTER DOUBLE-FIRES. admin-center.tsx:86-91 handleSearch calls setPage(1) then fetchWorkflows() immediately. When page > 1, setPage(1) also triggers the useEffect at :60-64 (page is a dependency), so two identical requests race; the loser can overwrite the winner's results because there is no request-sequence guard. The `search` state is deliberately excluded from the effect deps (:64 comment) but the manual call reintroduces the race.

BUSINESS UNIT SELECT IS HARDCODED-DISABLED, NOT DATA-DRIVEN. The API honestly returns business_units: [], business_units_available: false and a reason string (TalentDashboardController.php:632-634), and the type models all three (types/talent-dashboard.ts:117-124). But talent-dashboard.tsx:348-355 hardcodes `options={[{label:'Not configured'}]}` and `disabled`, ignoring options.business_units_available entirely. If a customer's tenant ever gains a business-unit master the select will stay dead. Related dead state: TalentDashboardFilters.businessUnit (use-talent-dashboard.ts:49) is declared, defaulted and never read — toQuery() at :61-69 omits it.

DEAD RETURN VALUES FROM THE HOOK. use-talent-dashboard.ts:123 returns `meta: {from,to}` (the server-echoed window) and the component never destructures it (talent-dashboard.tsx:226-240) — the range button shows the client's own filter string via formatRangeLabel instead of the window the server actually used. Likewise performance_cycle.cycle_status (types:50, returned at controller:290) is never rendered, so a 'closed' or 'draft' cycle is displayed identically to an 'active' one.
